page.meta_description: Edo's bay and night stalls are the setting of Edomae sushi. When the city was renamed Tokyo, the style kept the old name. Related pages: Edomae sushi, Tokyo.
page.content:
The city now called Tokyo, where nigiri became a street craft.

How Edo connects

  • Topic: Edomae sushi — Edomae sushi is the style of Edo, the city now called Tokyo.
  • Location: Tokyo — Edo is the former name and urban setting of what became Tokyo.

What is Edo?

Edo's bay and night stalls are the setting of Edomae sushi. When the city was renamed Tokyo, the style kept the old name.

Key threads lead to Edomae sushi and Tokyo.
